description_en: Updates the executor and model configurations of a workflow node
description_zh: 更新工作流节点的执行人与模型配置
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo update-workflow-node-configuration --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --instance-id inst_2081 --node-id node_7f3a2c --expected-version 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWorkflowNodeConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID；缺省使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the current physical plan
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the business node
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration version returned by the read operation. The value must be a non-negative integer. If a version conflict occurs, you must refresh the version
parameters.help_zh: 读取接口返回的configVersion；非负整数；版本冲突须刷新
parameters.name: expected_version

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs for the node owners. The value must be a non-empty array of positive integers. If this parameter is omitted, the current value is retained. If this parameter is set to null, the default value is restored
parameters.help_zh: 节点负责人用户ID列表，非空正整数数组；省略保持，null恢复默认
parameters.name: responsible_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The model mode. The quick value is normalized to standard. If this parameter is omitted, the current value is retained. If this parameter is set to null, the default value is restored
parameters.help_zh: 模型模式；quick归一化standard；省略保持，null恢复默认
parameters.name: model

fields.help_en: The executor ID. If the type is USER, the value is a string representing a positive integer platform user ID. If the type is AGENT, the value is the technical name of the digital worker in the workspace
fields.help_zh: USER 为正整数平台用户ID字符串；AGENT 为空间数字员工技术名称
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The executor type. Valid values: USER (a human user) and AGENT (a digital worker)
fields.help_zh: USER 真人或 AGENT 数字员工
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The executor of the node. If this parameter is omitted, the current value is retained. If this parameter is set to null, the default value is restored. You must modify at least one of the owner, model, or executor
parameters.help_zh: 节点执行人；省略保持，null恢复默认；与负责人、模型至少修改一项
parameters.name: executor

canEdit.description_en: Indicates whether the current user can edit this node
